summary.text: In the inventors' city of Ghirapur on Kaladesh, Chandra Nalaar returns home to find her mother Pia, who leads the renegades against the Consulate's grip on aether, taken prisoner at the Inventors' Fair.
With Nissa and Oviya Pashiri she tries to free Pia from the Dhund, where Baral, the scarred mage who hunted her family, traps them until Ajani frees them.
The Gatewatch then stands with Chandra in the arena against Tezzeret, but he retreats, having used the showdown as bait to have the Consulate confiscate all the Fair's inventions.
